**Finding resubmitted: Compliant** — no redline, no comment.

Repairs made in response to the feedback:

- **Tightened citations.** Dropped p0116 (§ 13.5 Employee NDA/Invention Agreement and IP ownership) and p0094 (§ 10 confidentiality use restriction), since neither imposes a non-solicit and citing them muddied the basis for compliance. The finding now cites only p0133 (§ 14.10), expressly framed as a scope anchor rather than as a restrictive covenant.
- **Strengthened the absence evidence.** Ran additional searches for "employ or engage", "recruit" and "personnel"; all personnel references (§ 5 training, § 13.1–13.3 access to Commerce One staff, § 14.5 independent contractors, Exhibit D § 5) concern provision and assignment of staff only, with no hiring restriction on either party.
- **Addressed the failing checks.** The 12-month duration and general-solicitation carve-out checks are non-applicable heuristics here — there is no clause to qualify — and the rationale now says so explicitly.
- **Preserved the residual-risk note.** § 14.10 incorporates a separate NDA and Statement of Work; if either contains a non-solicit, we hold it to the fallback (mutual, personnel directly involved, 12 months from end of involvement, general-advertising and unsolicited-approach carve-outs, no no-hire).

All three previously cited paragraphs remain unchanged, consistent with the preferred position that no non-solicit bind Corio.
